text_block_list.text: On the way home after staying out late enjoying an outing with Ms. Tazuna—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...I can feel it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I sense students approaching.
Two... no, three of them...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...That's a complete violation.
Curfew has long since passed.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, I'm off!
No sooner had she spoken than Tazuna-san dashed off in the blink of an eye.
choice_data_list: (It's getting late, so I'm kind of worried...)
(It's getting pretty late, so I'm worried...)

text_block_list.text:
I think I'll wait for Ms. Tazuna to get back
and walk her home.
Thinking so, I waited at the school gate, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
NOOOOO!
Tazuna-san, you're berry, berry fast...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Taiki Shuttle!
Get back to the dorm right now!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: NOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah... You won't get away!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ――Hmph!!
...Tazuna-san's acceleration was remarkable even from a Trainer's perspective!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Whew……

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh my?! Trainer!
Were you waiting for me...!
choice_data_list: That was an incredible turn of foot...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Umm, is that a sparkle in your eye?
I hope it's merely my imagination, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A dream?! Er, well... that Umamusume grow up healthy,
and that racing continues to flourish for ages to come...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer!?
choice_data_list: Would you be interested in making your debut?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!
Come back to your senses already, sheesh!
After Ms. Tazuna patted me lightly on the head, I finally managed to calm down.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that startled me...
Honestly, <username>-san.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...My debut, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu♪
